purpose: Runtime import for the encounter checker. This is not a creature browser and contains no raw SRD stat-block text.

damage.recharge: (maximum - minimum + 1) / 6 after the feature has been spent
action_economy: Choose one Action or Magic action per turn unless the stat block explicitly combines them.
A Bonus Action, Reaction, Legendary Action, and Lair Action use their own printed budget; none consumes or creates a normal Action unless the text says so.
Recharge controls availability only. Read activation_type from the section heading, never from the word Recharge.
A rechargeable Action replaces the routine Action; a rechargeable Bonus Action uses only the Bonus Action budget.
Schedule shared spell slots, N/Day Each, recharge, concentration, and once-per-turn riders before selecting the round's legal feature set.

interpretation.principle: Read the entered creature first. Its printed attack bonus, DC, damage dice, target wording, resource limit, and action section are the source of the combat calculation.
interpretation.named_spell_resolution: If a feature names a recognized spell and omits or abbreviates its mechanics, resolve the spell at the printed cast level from the versioned spell profile. A printed damage expression always wins.
interpretation.unknown_feature_policy: Never silently replace an unknown action or spell with a CR/tier DPR estimate. Mark it NEEDS DM INPUT or ESTIMATED and keep the uncertainty in the trace.
interpretation.trace_requirement: Every round reports each scheduled feature, activation channel, resource spent, hit/save expectation, target count, expected damage, and unresolved assumption.

sustain.effective_hp_rule: (raw_hp + explicit_same_encounter_pools) * ac_multiplier * PRODUCT(distinct_trait_multipliers) / damage_pass_fraction / damage_uptime * party_size_hp_multiplier
sustain.regression_evidence: 600/600 retained samples from the 80,000-case calibration reproduce exactly under the multiplicative rule.
sustain.anti_double_count: An effect entered as explicit healing, restore, prevention, damage pass, or uptime must not also receive its trait multiplier.

trait_rules.label: Relevant save / ABS -1 vs CR expectation [conditional]
Relevant save / ABS -2 vs CR expectation [conditional]
Relevant save / ABS -3 vs CR expectation [conditional]
Reactive resistance to last damage type
First attack each round at disadvantage
Concealment until first attack hits each round
Damage absorption / healing conversion
trait_rules.guidance: Explicit absorbed damage becomes healing; no fixed coefficient.

trait_rules.label: Damage transfer / redirection
trait_rules.guidance: Move damage to the linked body's own EHP pool; do not create HP.

trait_rules.label: Multiple forms / replacement body
trait_rules.guidance: Add only the HP pool that can occur in the same encounter.

trait_rules.label: Once-per-round damage halving
trait_rules.guidance: Expected prevented damage, limited to one legal Reaction.

trait_rules.label: Parry / reaction AC
trait_rules.guidance: Price only the expected attack affected; consumes the Reaction.

trait_rules.label: Limited spell immunity
trait_rules.guidance: Apply against the party's actual spell-tier damage share.

trait_rules.label: Spell reflection / turning
trait_rules.guidance: Prevention is sustain; reflected damage is separate DPR.

trait_rules.label: Conditional regeneration with shutoff
trait_rules.guidance: Use active rounds after applying the shutoff damage profile.

trait_rules.label: Damage threshold
trait_rules.guidance: Model per-hit distribution; never convert directly to flat HP.

trait_rules.label: Possession / body replacement
trait_rules.guidance: Use host/replacement pool only when legally available in-fight.

trait_rules.label: Shared HP / linked bodies
trait_rules.guidance: Use one shared pool and separate action bodies; do not multiply the pool.

trait_rules.label: Lair-action defense
trait_rules.guidance: Apply only while the lair condition is active.

trait_rules.label: Untargetable / unreachable windows
trait_rules.guidance: Represent through party damage uptime, not raw HP.

trait_rules.label: Condition immunity
trait_rules.guidance: Protects action uptime; no generic HP credit without a party control profile.

trait_rules.label: Rejuvenation after the encounter
trait_rules.guidance: Does not increase EHP in the current encounter.

trait_rules.label: Temporary HP
trait_rules.guidance: Add explicit available pool once; do not also use a trait multiplier.

trait_rules.label: Save reroll / inspiration
trait_rules.guidance: Apply to the affected save event, not every incoming attack.

trait_rules.label: Control that removes enemy actions
trait_rules.guidance: Reduce monster action uptime; do not add player HP.

survivor_projection.focus_fire: Equal per-PC sustain with sequential damage packing; projects the greatest number of individual downs for a given damage total.
survivor_projection.spread_evenly: Equal per-PC sustain with even damage allocation; all standing PCs are projected damaged until total party sustain is exhausted.
survivor_projection.precision: Downs, damaged-but-standing, and standing counts are model projections under the selected allocation, not observed combat outcomes.

parser.source_of_truth: Entered action text and numeric fields; do not use CR-band damage for identified actions.
parser.unknown_policy: NEEDS DM INPUT or ESTIMATED with trace; never silently use a lower spell tier or CR band.

equipmentModes.wotcStandard: No automatic combat bonus from unspecified magic items.
equipmentModes.brokenChain: Automatic four-PC generalized campaign baseline. Gift counts and Convergence maturity come from the authored drop checkpoint for the selected level; the user never selects loot for the checker.

provenance.statistic: weighted median using the workbook sample weights

generalized_broken_chain_progression.method: Deterministic 80,000-trial uniform average over legal immediate fusions and still-raw A4 Catalyst choices.
generalized_broken_chain_progression.scalar_scope: First-tab numbers add only unconditional explicit damage/prevention. Contextual movement, control, resistance bypass, rerolls, condition clearing, initiative, reactions, and attunement are retained in expected inventory for the app to resolve against the entered creature.
generalized_broken_chain_progression.gift_rule: The existing validated gear curve already includes the generalized +2 Gift chassis and average rider for 2 bearers at level 8 and all 4 bearers from level 9. Gift-specific context is represented as uniform unique Gift probabilities: 0.25 each at level 8 and 0.50 each from level 9.
generalized_broken_chain_progression.checkpoint_rule: Level 9 general Broken Chain mode is Act 4 entry: all 4 Gifts and all 11 guaranteed pre-Act-4 inputs are active. A3-10 is an encounter-preset exception with all 4 Gifts but only the 9 inputs earned through Gate I; Branchcall Marker and Held-Echo Knot drop after the finale.

effect_families.guidance: Apply the AC change only to eligible attacks and only while the reaction or duration is available.
Recalculate hit probability for the affected attacks; do not use a flat HP bonus.
Weight by the selected party's actual damage-type share and bypass rules.
Resolve against individual hits or per-round damage before summing; never convert blindly to flat HP.
Prevent eligible damage and add only explicitly granted healing; retain the damage-type trigger.
Track timing, uses, shutoff conditions, healing caps, and whether the pool can occur in this encounter.
Track the save, HP restored, uses, delay, and shutoff. Post-encounter rejuvenation gives no current-fight EHP.
Move damage between existing bodies or one shared pool; never duplicate the same HP.
Add only forms that legally appear in the same fight, with trigger and carry-over rules.
Model targetability, advantage/disadvantage, and reveal conditions rather than a permanent HP multiplier.
Change each side's reachable-target fraction only when terrain and ranges make the movement relevant.
Protect action uptime against matching party effects; give no universal EHP credit without that profile.
Spend uses against the most valuable failed saves and preserve the exact number of uses.
Follow the printed sequence and alternatives; do not add every listed attack together.
Keep recharge probability separate from activation type; a recharge Action replaces the routine Action.
Add only separately legal actions, honoring costs, triggers, uses, and initiative timing.
Multiply expected per-target damage by exposed targets and active rounds, respecting repeat saves and exits.
Use expected eligible triggers; death effects occur once and reflected damage remains separate from prevented damage.
Recalculate hit and rider probability from the chance the positional or target condition is met.
Use the stat block's own spells, uses, and slots. Actual spell text overrides tier fallback values.
Prevent or redirect eligible spell events using range, reaction, check, tier, and use constraints.

Price deterministic consequences rather than treating control as zero. Forced movement/speed changes recalculate whether the affected target can reach with its best legal action; if movement is 0 and no legal attack/spell reaches, that normal-action DPR becomes 0. Prone reprices melee/ranged hit probabilities and standing consumes half speed. Grapple sets speed 0 but does not itself remove actions; restraint reprices attacks against/by the target. Escape actions are priced as lost normal-action DPR when rationally chosen.

Price disabled action channels directly by duration. Stun/incapacitate remove legal actions/reactions; paralysis also reprices attacks against the target and melee critical hits; fear reprices attack disadvantage and movement restriction while the source is visible. Charm alone has no generic DPR price unless it removes or redirects actions.
Track the altered pool or disabled recovery separately from immediate damage and reset it at the stated cadence.
Report fatal/down probability and trigger round; never disguise the effect as ordinary DPR.
Add each created body as a timed roster entry with its own HP, actions, duration, and initiative.
Switch offense, defenses, size, or traits at the printed HP/state threshold.
Enable only when the encounter location and initiative procedure satisfy the requirement.

progression.runner_default: Run each preset at its recorded entry party state. Encounters are independent planned fights unless a future campaign mode explicitly carries damage or resources between them.

balance_policy.individual_variance: Permitted. Do not force every normal encounter into one identical difficulty band.
balance_policy.stage_review: Review the stage's normal encounters and its reward gate together; a lighter normal encounter may deliberately sit beside a higher-pressure encounter or gate.
balance_policy.gate_reward_timing: Run the gate with its entry level and already-earned loadout. Apply a level, Convergence unlock, or Feywild Gift wave only after the gate is won, starting with the next preset.
balance_policy.gift_selection: Four-PC Broken Chain mode uses the generalized unique-Gift expectation automatically: 2 Gifts after Mirrors and all 4 after the Moonstone Dragon. WotC Standard receives none. The Act 3 finale is fought with all 4 Gifts.

authored_reward_ledger.recipients: generalized two-of-eight unique Gift expectation for the four-PC checker

exit_on_completion.policy: Frozen Hollow first; run the opposite branch order as a distinct scenario.

campaign_semantics.whole_body_attrition: A living creature retains its full legal output until its body reaches 0 HP. Do not linearly reduce a singleton's DPR as its HP is chipped.
campaign_semantics.final_round: Use a single initiative model; never apply an extra completion-round damage discount on top of midpoint/whole-body attrition.

source_policy.bundled: compact rule/effect/spell data and private campaign profiles
source_policy.local_input: owned non-SRD WotC or homebrew stat blocks are parsed locally and are not redistributed
source_policy.excluded: raw SRD monster prose, non-SRD creature text, and unlicensed third-party creature data

authority.rule: The application reads this package, validates its SHA-256 at build/release time, and never reads workbook cells as runtime authority.

campaign_baseline.rule: WotC Standard is the default general checker and never receives Broken Chain equipment. Broken Chain Campaign is a separate mode that automatically uses the authored four-PC expected reward state for the selected level; no Gift, fusion, or Tier 4 selection is required from the user.
campaign_baseline.reward_summary: Gate I unlocks Crosspath Token and Rootbound Thread. Mirrors unlock 2 Gifts; the Moonstone Dragon unlocks the remaining 2, so A3-10 is fought with all 4. The Act 3 finale unlocks Branchcall Marker and Held-Echo Knot for Act 4. By the pre-UR cutoff, the four-PC party can acquire all 8 Ruined A4 inputs and 4 Catalysts.

rules.ordinary_convergence: Two legal unlike-tag raw inputs form one completed Tier 1-3 output; failed combinations consume nothing.
rules.tier4: One Catalyst tempers one still-raw Ruined A4 into its same-tag Tier 4 Singular; a creature can bind only one Tier 4 Singular.
rules.audit_raw_inputs: acquired raw inputs - 2 * ordinary completed Tier 1-3 outputs - tempered Tier 4 Singulars
rules.campaign_scaler: WotC Standard receives no Broken Chain items. Broken Chain Campaign uses the expected four-PC inventory generated from the authored level checkpoint; the checker user does not select or assign Gifts, fusions, or Tier 4 items.

gifts.name: Gift of the Realmkeeper
gifts.rules: Gift of the Realmkeeper Feywild Gift · One-Handed Strength Weapon · +2 · Requires Attunement Feywild Weapon Training. When you make a weapon attack with this Gift, you are considered proficient with it. Use the normal base damage die or dice of the chosen weapon form. The Gift grants a +2 bonus to its weapon attack and normal weapon damage rolls, and you add your Proficiency Bonus to its normal weapon damage roll. Effect. Once on each of your turns when you hit with the Gift, choose yourself or one creature you can see within 5 feet of you. The chosen creature gains 1d6 temporary hit points.

gifts.name: Gift of the Last Measure
gifts.rules: Gift of the Last Measure Feywild Gift · Two-Handed Strength Weapon · +2 · Requires Attunement Feywild Weapon Training. When you make a weapon attack with this Gift, you are considered proficient with it. Use the normal base damage die or dice of the chosen weapon form. The Gift grants a +2 bonus to its weapon attack and normal weapon damage rolls, and you add your Proficiency Bonus to its normal weapon damage roll. Effect. Once on each of your turns when you hit with the Gift while you have no more than half your hit point maximum, the hit deals an extra 2d6 damage of the weapon’s type.

gifts.name: Gift of the Hunter's Bounty
gifts.rules: Gift of the Hunter's Bounty Feywild Gift · Ranged Weapon · +2 · Requires Attunement Feywild Weapon Training. When you make a weapon attack with this Gift, you are considered proficient with it. Use the normal base damage die or dice of the chosen weapon form. The Gift grants a +2 bonus to its weapon attack and normal weapon damage rolls, and you add your Proficiency Bonus to its normal weapon damage roll. Effect. The first attack you make with the Gift on each of your turns carries its rider. If that attack hits, it deals an extra 1d8 damage of the weapon’s type. If it misses, the rider is spent for that turn.

gifts.name: Gift of the Necessary Cull
gifts.rules: Gift of the Necessary Cull Feywild Gift · Thrown Weapon · +2 · Requires Attunement Feywild Weapon Training. When you make a weapon attack with this Gift, you are considered proficient with it. Use the normal base damage die or dice of the chosen weapon form. The Gift grants a +2 bonus to its weapon attack and normal weapon damage rolls, and you add your Proficiency Bonus to its normal weapon damage roll. Effect. The Gift returns to your hand immediately after a ranged attack with it resolves. Once on each of your turns, when you hit a creature with the Gift after you have already hit that same creature with an attack this turn, the hit deals an extra 2d6 damage of the weapon’s type.

gifts.name: Gift of the Open Way
gifts.rules: Gift of the Open Way Feywild Gift · Finesse or Light Melee Weapon · +2 · Requires Attunement Feywild Weapon Training. When you make a weapon attack with this Gift, you are considered proficient with it. Use the normal base damage die or dice of the chosen weapon form. The Gift grants a +2 bonus to its weapon attack and normal weapon damage rolls, and you add your Proficiency Bonus to its normal weapon damage roll. Effect. Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with the Gift, that creature cannot make opportunity attacks until the start of your next turn.

gifts.name: Gift of the Last Gate
gifts.rules: Gift of the Last Gate Feywild Gift · Reach Weapon · +2 · Requires Attunement Feywild Weapon Training. When you make a weapon attack with this Gift, you are considered proficient with it. Use the normal base damage die or dice of the chosen weapon form. The Gift grants a +2 bonus to its weapon attack and normal weapon damage rolls, and you add your Proficiency Bonus to its normal weapon damage roll. Effect. Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with the Gift, its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. If the hit is an Opportunity Attack, that creature’s Speed becomes 0 for the rest of the current turn.

gifts.name: Gift of the First Word
gifts.rules: Gift of the First Word Feywild Gift · Two-Handed Spellcasting Focus · +2 · Requires Attunement Feywild Weapon Training. When you make a weapon attack with this Gift, you are considered proficient with it. Use the normal base damage die or dice of the chosen weapon form. The Gift grants a +2 bonus to its weapon attack and normal weapon damage rolls, and you add your Proficiency Bonus to its normal weapon damage roll. Spellcasting Focus. While wielding the Gift in two hands, you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls and spell save DC. Effect. Once on each of your turns when you cast a spell through the Gift, choose one creature affected by the spell. If the spell deals damage to that creature, it takes an extra 1d6 damage of one damage type dealt by the spell; if the spell restores hit points to that creature, it regains an extra 1d6 hit points instead.

gifts.name: Gift of the Last Word
gifts.rules: Gift of the Last Word Feywild Gift · One-Handed Battle Focus · +2 · Requires Attunement Feywild Weapon Training. When you make a weapon attack with this Gift, you are considered proficient with it. Use the normal base damage die or dice of the chosen weapon form. The Gift grants a +2 bonus to its weapon attack and normal weapon damage rolls, and you add your Proficiency Bonus to its normal weapon damage roll. Spellcasting Focus. You gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls and spell save DC while wielding the Gift. Effect. Once on each of your turns when you cast a spell through the Gift, it can become armed until the end of your next turn. The first weapon attack you hit with while it is armed deals an extra 1d8 force damage, then the Gift disarms. Only one Last Word can be armed at a time; casting another spell through it refreshes or replaces the armed state.

act3_inputs.name: Crosspath Token
act3_inputs.rules: Crosspath Token Wondrous Item · Convergence Input · A3 Effect. Once per day, after Initiative is rolled and before the first turn begins, choose one hostile creature you can see that has a higher Initiative than you. Move your Initiative to immediately after that creature. Only your Initiative changes.

act3_inputs.name: Rootbound Thread
act3_inputs.rules: Rootbound Thread Wondrous Item · Convergence Input · A3 Effect. Once per day, when you fail a Constitution saving throw to maintain Concentration, you can succeed instead.

act3_inputs.name: Bloodbriar Seed
act3_inputs.rules: Bloodbriar Seed Wondrous Item · Convergence Input · A3 Effect. Once per day, when you damage a creature, prime it until the end of the current round. The first allied hit against that creature before then deals an additional 2d8 damage of one damage type dealt by that hit.

act3_inputs.name: Mirrorbark Scale
act3_inputs.rules: Mirrorbark Scale Wondrous Item · Convergence Input · A3 Effect. Once per day, when an attack hits you, you can use your Reaction to force the triggering attack roll to be rerolled and use the new roll.

act3_inputs.name: Branchcall Marker
act3_inputs.rules: Branchcall Marker Wondrous Item · Convergence Input · A3 Effect. Once per day, when a creature you can see within 30 feet ends its turn, you can use your Reaction. You and one willing creature you can see within 30 feet can each move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

act3_inputs.name: Held-Echo Knot
act3_inputs.rules: Held-Echo Knot Wondrous Item · Convergence Input · A3 Effect. Once per day, when a hostile creature's Reaction causes a non-spell limited-use class feature you used to have no effect, recover one non-spell resource spent on that feature. This property never refunds spell slots, spell uses, or the Reaction economy itself.

act3_inputs.name: Veilwash Leaf
act3_inputs.rules: Veilwash Leaf Wondrous Item · Convergence Input · A3 Effect. Once per day, as a Magic action, touch a creature and end one of the following conditions on it: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.

act3_inputs.name: Thornwake Splinter
act3_inputs.rules: Thornwake Splinter Wondrous Item · Convergence Input · A3 Effect. Once per day, when you deal damage with an attack, you can cause the splinter to flare. The creature takes an additional 2d8 damage of one damage type dealt by that attack.

act4_ruined.name: Blinkstep
act4_ruined.rules: Blinkstep Ruined A4 · Movement Source. Act 4 sequence 1 — first required Level 9 fight Effect. Bonus Action · 1/Short Rest: teleport up to 20 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

act4_ruined.name: Deferred Wound
act4_ruined.rules: Deferred Wound Ruined A4 · Defense Source. Act 4 sequence 2 — second required Level 9 fight Effect. Reaction · 1/Long Rest: when you take damage, roll 2d8. Reduce the triggering damage by up to the roll and record the amount actually reduced as deferred damage. Healing before the end of the current round removes deferred damage first. At round end, lose HP equal to any deferred damage that remains. The original hit still counts as a hit/damage event; deferred resolution does not retrigger hit/damage riders.

act4_ruined.name: Rupture
act4_ruined.rules: Rupture Ruined A4 · Offensive Source. Act 4 sequence 3 — Phoenix Effect. Rider · 1/Long Rest: when you hit, deal an additional 2d10 damage of one damage type dealt by that attack.

act4_ruined.name: Applied Insight
act4_ruined.rules: Applied Insight Ruined A4 · Utility Source. Act 4 sequence 4 — first required Level 10 fight Effect. Reaction · 1/Long Rest: after you or an ally within 30 feet fails an ability check, add 1d10 to the result, potentially turning it into a success.

act4_ruined.name: True Ground
act4_ruined.rules: True Ground Ruined A4 · Stability Source. Act 4 sequence 5 — second required Level 10 fight Effect. Bonus Action · 1/Short Rest: anchor your current space until the end of the current round. If a hostile effect moves you against your will, after that movement resolves teleport back to the anchor or the nearest space you can occupy.

act4_ruined.name: Condition Vessel
act4_ruined.rules: Condition Vessel Ruined A4 · Cleanse Source. Act 4 sequence 6 — Elemental level fight Effect. Magic Action · 1/Long Rest: end Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Restrained on one willing creature within 30 feet. You gain that condition until the end of the current round. You cannot use this property for a condition you are immune to.

act4_ruined.name: Threat Positioning
act4_ruined.rules: Threat Positioning Ruined A4 · Tactical Source. Act 4 sequence 7 — Construct / Ward outpost entrance Effect. 1/Long Rest, immediately after Initiative is rolled and before the first turn: choose one visible hostile creature and move your Initiative to immediately after it. The hostile creature does not move.

act4_ruined.name: Preserved Reaction
act4_ruined.rules: Preserved Reaction Ruined A4 · Continuity Source. Act 4 sequence 8 — required outpost/cavern fight Effect. 1/Long Rest: when you use your normal Reaction for a standard non-spell Reaction, expend this item’s charge instead of expending your Reaction. All other costs remain. Eligible uses are Opportunity Attacks, non-spell class/subclass/feat/item Reactions, or release of a Readied non-spell action or movement. Reaction spells, Readied spells, and Bond reactions are excluded.

tier1.name: Anchor Thread
tier1.rules: Anchor Thread Wondrous Item · Convergence Tier 1 Effect. Once per long rest, when an effect would move you against your will or knock you prone, you can ignore the forced movement or remain standing.

tier1.name: Clarity Hood
tier1.rules: Clarity Hood Wondrous Item · Convergence Tier 1 Effect. Once per long rest, when you fail a saving throw against being Charmed or Frightened, or against an illusion spell or effect, reroll the save and use the new result.

tier1.name: Step Stabilizer
tier1.rules: Step Stabilizer Wondrous Item · Convergence Tier 1 Effect. Natural difficult terrain costs you no extra movement. Once per short or long rest, you can take the Disengage action as a Bonus Action.

tier1.name: Reinforced Wrap
tier1.rules: Reinforced Wrap Wondrous Item · Convergence Tier 1 Effect. Once per long rest, when an attack hits you, you can use your Reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10.

tier1.name: Lensing Glass
tier1.rules: Lensing Glass Wondrous Item · Convergence Tier 1 · 2 charges Effect. As a Bonus Action, expend 1 charge. Until the end of your next turn, you can see Invisible creatures and see through magical visual obscurement within 30 feet. The glass regains all expended charges when you finish a long rest.

tier1.name: Splitgrain Grip
tier1.rules: Splitgrain Grip Wondrous Item · Convergence Tier 1 Effect. Once per long rest, when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal an additional 1d6 damage of one damage type dealt by the attack. Immediately after the attack, you can move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from that creature.

tier2.name: Drift Anchor
tier2.rules: Drift Anchor Wondrous Item · Convergence Tier 2 Effect. You have advantage on saving throws against being moved against your will or knocked prone. Once per day at dawn recharge, when either effect would happen, you can ignore it entirely.

tier2.name: Hollowlight
tier2.rules: Hollowlight Wondrous Item · Convergence Tier 2 Effect. You can see through magical darkness within 30 feet. Once per day, when you fail a saving throw against being Blinded, Charmed, Frightened, or Restrained, you can reroll the save and use the new result.

tier2.name: Quickstep
tier2.rules: Quickstep Wondrous Item · Convergence Tier 2 Effect. Your speed increases by 5 feet and difficult terrain costs you no extra movement. Once per day, you can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action; your movement does not provoke opportunity attacks until the end of that turn.

tier2.name: Edgeworn
tier2.rules: Edgeworn Wondrous Item · Convergence Tier 2 Effect. Once per day, when you hit with a weapon attack, choose one damage type dealt by the hit. For that hit, resistance to the chosen type is ignored, and immunity to the chosen type is treated as resistance.

tier2.name: Driftveil
tier2.rules: Driftveil Wondrous Item · Convergence Tier 2 Effect. Once per day, when an attack hits you, you can use your Reaction to move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks and reduce the triggering attack’s damage by 1d8.

tier2.name: Clearward Mantle
tier2.rules: Clearward Mantle Wondrous Item · Convergence Tier 2 Effect. You have advantage on saving throws against gaining the Poisoned condition. Once per day, as a Bonus Action, end one of the following conditions on yourself: Blinded, Charmed, Frightened, or Poisoned.

tier2.name: Turnstep Relay
tier2.rules: Turnstep Relay Wondrous Item · Convergence Tier 2 Effect. Once per day, when a hostile creature you can see within 30 feet starts its turn, you can use your Reaction to move up to half your Speed without provoking opportunity attacks. This movement occurs before that creature takes any action or movement.

tier2.name: Opening Thorn
tier2.rules: Opening Thorn Wondrous Item · Convergence Tier 2 Effect. Once per day, when you deal damage to a creature, you can expose an opening until the start of your next turn. The next attack roll made by another creature against that target has advantage. If that attack hits, the attacker can immediately move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from the target.

tier2.name: Heldroot Knot
tier2.rules: Heldroot Knot Wondrous Item · Convergence Tier 2 Effect. Once per day, when a creature's Reaction causes an action you take to fail or prevents it from resolving, choose one spell slot, charge, or limited-use class resource you expended as part of that action. That resource is not expended. The creature's Reaction otherwise resolves normally.

tier2.name: Rootfast Loop
tier2.rules: Rootfast Loop Wondrous Item · Convergence Tier 2 Effect. Once per day, when you fail a Constitution saving throw to maintain Concentration, you can succeed instead.

tier4.name: Blinkstep
tier4.rules: Blinkstep — Tempered Tier 4 Singular · Movement · Requires attunement Effect. Active — 1/Encounter: teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Passive — your Speed increases by 10 feet.

tier4.name: Applied Insight
tier4.rules: Applied Insight — Tempered Tier 4 Singular · Utility · Requires attunement Effect. Active — Reaction · 1/Short Rest: after you or an ally within 30 feet fails an ability check, add 1d12 to the result, potentially succeeding. Passive — after each Long Rest, choose one skill or tool; you gain proficiency with it until your next Long Rest.

tier4.name: Deferred Wound
tier4.rules: Deferred Wound — Tempered Tier 4 Singular · Defense · Requires attunement Effect. Active — Reaction · 1/Short Rest: Deferred Wound uses 2d10 instead of 2d8. Passive — if all deferred damage is cleared before it resolves at round end, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

tier4.name: True Ground
tier4.rules: True Ground — Tempered Tier 4 Singular · Stability · Requires attunement Effect. Active — 1/Encounter: the anchor lasts until the start of your next turn and also answers hostile teleportation, returning you to the anchor or nearest space you can occupy after the hostile displacement resolves. Passive — once per round, reduce forced movement applied to you by 10 feet.

tier4.name: Condition Vessel
tier4.rules: Condition Vessel — Tempered Tier 4 Singular · Cleanse · Requires attunement Effect. Active — Magic Action · 1/Short Rest: end one listed Condition on a willing creature within 30 feet; the extracted condition ends without transferring to you. Passive — you have advantage on saving throws against Charmed, Frightened, and Poisoned.

tier4.name: Rupture
tier4.rules: Rupture — Tempered Tier 4 Singular · Offensive · Requires attunement Effect. Active — Rider · 1/Short Rest: when you hit, deal an additional 2d12 damage of one damage type dealt by the attack, and the target cannot regain Hit Points until the start of your next turn. Passive — once on each of your turns, one damage die showing 1 may count as 2.

tier4.name: Threat Positioning
tier4.rules: Threat Positioning — Tempered Tier 4 Singular · Tactical · Requires attunement Effect. Active — 1/Short Rest, immediately after Initiative is rolled and before the first turn: exchange your Initiative with one visible hostile creature. Initiative is never moved mid-round, and this cannot create double or skipped turns. Passive — when a hostile creature immediately before you in Initiative finishes its turn, gain +2 to your next saving throw before the end of your next turn.

tier4.name: Preserved Reaction
tier4.rules: Preserved Reaction — Tempered Tier 4 Singular · Continuity · Requires attunement Effect. Active — 1/Short Rest: use the A4 Preserved Reaction substitution. If a hostile creature caused the trigger, its next attempted Reaction before the start of its next turn is suppressed; then the suppression ends. Passive — Held Intent: when you Ready a non-spell action or movement and its trigger does not occur before the start of your next turn, it remains Readied until the end of that turn. Only one Readied intent can be preserved this way.

creature_estimator.scope: 2014 WotC DMG-style monster rating through CR 25. It is a creature-construction estimate, not a target-by-target encounter lethality result.

source.publication: Dungeon Master's Guide (2014), chapter 9, Monster Statistics by Challenge Rating

creature_estimator.multiplier_bridge: For compatibility with an additive-EHP interface, flat_equivalent_from_multiplier = raw_hp * (source_traced_ehp_multiplier - 1). Adding that equivalent back to raw HP is mathematically identical to raw_hp * multiplier.
creature_estimator.combination_rule: Multiply independent calibrated sustain factors to produce source_traced_ehp_multiplier. Apply a trait to exactly one channel: multiplier, flat EHP adjustment, or AC adjustment. Never double-count the same trait.
creature_estimator.defensive_cr: Find base defensive CR from source-traced effective HP. Compare source-traced effective AC with the table AC for that base CR; shift defensive CR by 1 for every full 2 points of difference.
creature_estimator.offensive_cr: Average the creature's highest legal expected damage sequence over its first 3 rounds. Find base offensive CR from damage per round. Compare the creature's attack bonus or save DC with the table expectation for that base CR; shift offensive CR by 1 for every full 2 points of difference.
creature_estimator.final_cr: Average adjusted defensive CR and adjusted offensive CR, then round to the nearest CR. Values above the encoded CR 25 cap require manual review.
creature_estimator.action_budget_rule: Damage must come from parsed legal actions, Bonus Actions, Reactions, Legendary Actions, lair actions, Recharge, spell slots, limited uses, target counts, saves, and printed timing. A spell's actual level and damage are never replaced with a lower generic tier budget.
creature_estimator.editor_rule: Use the desired CR baseline deltas as editing guidance, preserve authored action channels and timing, then rerun the parser and per-target encounter trace.

encounter_outcomes.aggregate_audit_rule: Equal-sustain downs and residual damage are aggregate projections only. They are never counts of individual damaged or untouched PCs.
encounter_outcomes.target_trace_rule: The application resolves packets by target, individual saves/prevention, full-party AoEs, control, and sequencing. A caught full-party AoE damages every caught PC even if the aggregate residual-damage flag is one.

pricing_contract.purpose: Deterministic pricing rules for parser/runtime mechanics. Prefer event/target traces over generic multipliers whenever the entered stat block and party profile provide enough information.
principles: Price direct attacks, saves, multiattack, target counts, action economy, Recharge, and limited uses automatically when their printed inputs are known.
Do not default an area effect to one target when no target count is known; use an authored runtime benchmark or mark NEEDS DM INPUT.
Control is not automatically unpriceable. Price its direct, deterministic consequence on action uptime, hit probability, reachability, or sustain when the target trace provides the required context.
Never double count the same effect in both an event trace and a calibrated sustain multiplier.
Unknown mechanics remain explicit NEEDS DM INPUT or ESTIMATED; never substitute CR-band damage.

rules.formula: p_hit = clamp((21 + attack_bonus - target_AC)/20, .05, .95); expected = p_hit × hit damage + crit increment if modeled.
rules.trace: Use printed attack bonus, damage, reach/range, and target AC.

rules.formula: Resolve the printed legal sequence and sum the expected values of its component attacks/actions. Alternatives are not added together.
rules.trace: Respect replacement attacks and conditional sequence branches.

rules.formula: p_fail = clamp((DC - save_bonus - 1)/20, 0, 1); expected = p_fail×failure damage + (1-p_fail)×success damage.
rules.trace: Use printed success damage; 'half as much' = 0.5 of failure damage.

rules.formula: Expected per-target damage × authored/explicit expected target count.
rules.trace: Do not silently default an area to 1 target. Use runtime benchmark only when explicitly authored; otherwise NEEDS DM INPUT.

rules.formula: Available on R1 if initially charged. After use, later-round availability = (max-min+1)/6. A recharge Action replaces the routine Action; BA/Reaction recharge uses its own channel.
rules.trace: Schedule the higher legal expected-value choice each round.

rules.formula: Schedule uses across the modeled rounds where they produce the greatest legal expected value; never exceed printed uses.
rules.trace: Shared pools and spell slots must be scheduled before action selection.

rules.formula: Price separately from the normal Action when legally compatible. Honor triggers, costs, uses, and initiative timing.
rules.trace: Never create an extra normal Action unless text says so.

rules.formula: Price expected lost target DPR after displacement. If remaining movement is 0 and no legal attack/spell can reach from the new distance, next normal-action DPR = 0. If target can re-enter range with available movement, no direct DPR loss. Trigger-weight by hit/save probability.
rules.trace: If only Dash can restore range, normal-action DPR is 0 for that turn; separately legal BA/Reaction damage remains.

rules.formula: Recompute reachable distance using remaining/effective movement. Reduce target DPR only when its best legal action can no longer reach; if none can reach, affected action DPR = 0.
rules.trace: No arbitrary flat penalty merely for losing feet of movement.

rules.formula: Against a prone target, attacks from ≤5 ft gain advantage and attacks from >5 ft have disadvantage. Reprice eligible attack hit rates. Standing consumes half speed and then feeds the reachability rule.
rules.trace: When the creature is prone, this is primarily a sustain penalty against melee attackers; when a PC is prone, it increases eligible monster melee offense.

rules.formula: Speed becomes 0. Do not remove actions. Price only consequences caused by zero movement, forced relocation, escape-action use, or linked attack conditions.
rules.trace: If escape requires the Action and is rationally chosen, that turn's normal-action DPR becomes 0.

rules.formula: Target attacks have disadvantage; attacks against target have advantage; Dex saves have disadvantage. Recalculate affected hit/save probabilities for duration.
rules.trace: Combine with escape-action probability if applicable.

rules.formula: While source is visible, target attacks/checks have disadvantage; target cannot willingly move closer. Reprice attack DPR and reachability.
rules.trace: No penalty when source is not visible or the best action is unaffected.

rules.formula: Reprice affected attacks using advantage/disadvantage and targetability/reveal conditions.
rules.trace: Do not convert permanent-looking concealment into flat HP when it ends on a trigger.

rules.formula: Set affected Action/BA/Reaction uptime to 0 for the disabled duration, except anything the condition explicitly allows. Stunned also grants advantage to attacks against the target.
rules.trace: Price lost turns directly, not as HP.

rules.formula: Lost action uptime as incapacitated; attacks against target gain advantage; hits from within 5 ft that land are critical hits. Reprice incoming melee damage by melee share.
rules.trace: Use actual attack mix and duration.

rules.formula: Charm alone receives no generic DPR value beyond the printed targeting/hostility restriction. If control redirects or removes actions, price those action events explicitly.
rules.trace: Dominate/command effects need per-action target logic.

rules.formula: Remove only the expected Reaction DPR/control that the target could legally have generated during the affected window.
rules.trace: No value if the target has no relevant Reaction event.

rules.formula: Recalculate p_hit using two d20s: advantage = 1-(1-p)^2; disadvantage = p^2, then multiply affected damage.
rules.trace: Apply only to eligible attacks and duration.

rules.formula: Recompute opposing attack hit probability for eligible attacks using modified AC. Half cover +2; three-quarters cover +5 when printed/applicable.
rules.trace: Do not apply to save-based damage.

rules.formula: Recalculate the specific save event probability; limited rerolls are spent on the highest-value eligible failed save.
rules.trace: Do not apply a blanket HP multiplier unless using a calibrated trait explicitly.

rules.formula: Weight by the opposing side's actual eligible damage-type share and bypass rules; immunity passes 0 eligible damage, resistance 0.5, vulnerability 2.0.
rules.trace: Use campaign magic-weapon/bypass state.

rules.formula: Apply per eligible hit or per round before summing. Never convert directly to flat HP.
rules.trace: Requires hit-size distribution; thresholds can make small hits 0.

rules.formula: Add only pools/healing that can legally occur in the encounter, respecting timing, shutoff, caps, and uses.
rules.trace: Do not also apply a trait multiplier for the same pool.

rules.formula: Model as a state transition or explicit same-encounter HP pool; add only the pool that actually becomes available.
rules.trace: Post-encounter rejuvenation gives 0 current-fight EHP.

rules.formula: Price expected prevention on the single legal Reaction event, consuming the Reaction.
rules.trace: Choose the highest-value eligible incoming event when rational.

rules.formula: Reprice affected save events using save advantage and/or success-damage rules; calibrated multiplier may be used only when event trace is unavailable and must not double count.
rules.trace: Prefer event pricing when target profile is known.

rules.formula: Resolve recognized spell text at printed cast level; schedule slots and concentration legally. Printed feature text overrides spell profile.
rules.trace: Unknown spell/feature remains NEEDS DM INPUT, never CR-tier fallback.

rules.formula: Price prevented eligible spell event(s) using range, Reaction, slot/check rules; reflected damage is separate offense.
rules.trace: No value against parties with no eligible spell event.

rules.formula: Expected per-target damage × exposed target count × active rounds, respecting repeat saves, exits, start/end-turn timing, and concentration.
rules.trace: Avoid double counting entry and start-turn triggers.

rules.formula: Expected eligible trigger count × expected damage; death burst occurs once.
rules.trace: Reflected prevention and reflected damage are separate channels.

rules.formula: Create timed child body/bodies with own HP, actions, duration, and initiative; add only while legally present.
rules.trace: Do not fold child HP into parent and also keep child actions without a trace.

rules.formula: Move damage among existing pools according to the printed rule; never duplicate HP. Replacement host/form adds only legally available pool.
rules.trace: Track which body remains targetable and which actions remain.

rules.formula: Recompute opposing reachable-target fraction and damage uptime from actual ranges and terrain.
rules.trace: No generic value when both sides can still reach normally.

rules.formula: Prevent only matching control events from the opposing profile; no universal EHP credit without those events.
rules.trace: Keep as tag-only when party control profile is unknown.

rules.mechanic: Max-HP reduction / healing block / resource drain
rules.formula: Track altered sustain/resource pool separately from immediate damage; apply only for the printed duration/reset.
rules.trace: Long-horizon effects that do not matter in the current fight get no current-fight credit.

rules.formula: Report down/fatal probability and trigger round separately; do not disguise as ordinary DPR.
rules.trace: Requires target HP-state distribution.

target_defense_resolution.attack_target_ac: Resolve from party_defense_curve by selected mode and level unless the user/runtime supplies a more specific target profile.
target_defense_resolution.save_target_bonus: Resolve from party_defense_curve by selected mode, level, and save ability.
target_defense_resolution.manual_override: A specific encounter trace may override the general average for an authored target (frontliner, caster, marked target, etc.).
target_defense_resolution.anti_double_count: Do not also apply a generic AC/save multiplier after the event has been repriced against the selected defense profile.

party_defense_curve.scope: Four-PC encounter pricing target profile by party level and mode
party_defense_curve.important_limit: The v7 runtime bundle preserves aggregated DPR/sustain curves and provenance to Run Models A45:BD2092, but not the individual 128-party AC/save rows. Values below are a standard-progression proxy with a conservative Broken Chain unconditional AC overlay; replace with empirical averages when the source Run Models workbook is supplied.

targeting_rule.attack_roll: Use average_ac unless an authored target profile is explicitly named.
targeting_rule.saving_throw: Use the matching ability save average.
targeting_rule.conditional_defense: Shield spells, cover, rerolls, resistance, condition-specific advantage, and Convergence defenses are priced per event and are not baked into the averages.
targeting_rule.frontline_backline: Supported by the pricing contract, but not populated until empirical per-role rows are available.

broken_chain_overlay_basis.rule: Only unconditional generalized AC uplift is baked into the curve.
source_notes: Campaign loot includes class-compatible armor and shield upgrades; unique loot selection and conditional defensive effects are not uniformly guaranteed across the 128-party field.

The existing v7 generalized campaign progression already keeps contextual movement, control, resistance bypass, rerolls, condition clearing, initiative, reactions, and attunement for runtime resolution rather than scalarizing them.
